errors.text_span: Two sets of bars are presented for each model: a green bar representing “Our Joint Framework” and a light blue bar representing “LLM Models”.
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the chart as a grouped bar chart. The figure is a simple bar chart where each category on the x-axis corresponds to a single bar. The legend indicates the type of model each bar represents (i.e., the first bar is 'Our Joint Framework' and the other four are 'LLM Models'), not that there are two bars for each model.
